name: Every screen run leaves an append-only record of what it attempted — and a re-run under identical pins says so before it walks
notes: Re-verified goal-desk-iter-30 by browser-qa-agent. TC-1 (the honest empty 'No screen runs recorded yet.' state) was captured this iteration on a FRESH scoped rig -- a second backend (127.0.0.1:8302) with TAPEOLOGY_DESK_UNIVERSE_DIR pointed at a brand-new, never-populated directory, and a second frontend (127.0.0.1:3302, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8302, NEXT_DIST_DIR scoped) -- as the FIRST browser action against that rig, before any Run Screen click: GET /research/desk/screen/runs on that backend returned {"runs":[],"latest":null,"integrity_errors":[]}, and /desk rendered data-testid="desk-screen-runs-empty" with text 'No screen runs recorded yet.' (screenshot reports/qa/goal-desk-iter-30-evidence/J-18-empty-state.png). The rig was torn down at the end of the same dispatch and is NOT referenced by this replay script -- this script targets the ambient store only.

This replay script is DELIBERATELY READ-ONLY (goto only, no click on 'Run Screen'), mirroring the J-09 precedent: the button triggers a real ~101-symbol walk against cached bar data whenever the day's five pins are new, which would make every regression replay pay for (and depend on the timing of) a real compute. Instead this script re-reads the ambient store's own screen_runs log, populated by real 'Run Screen' clicks in prior iterations (goal-desk-iter-29).

goal-desk-iter-30 fix (iteration-summarizer/audit note): iter-29's audit (finding T1) flagged the PRIOR version of this script for pinning steps 2-3 to a specific run/screen id embedded in the expected text (e.g. 'reused screen-2026-07-31-c169546856c7 -- no walk was performed' and the 'latest run' detail block's exact zeroed counts) -- both change identity on every real ambient Run Screen click, so the very next real run anywhere in the pipeline would report a false regression. This version instead asserts STABLE substrings against the append-only desk-screen-runs-table testid's own rows, which never disappear once written: '101 / 101' (a completed full-walk row's attempted/total cell) and 'no walk was performed' (any reused row's outcome cell). Neither substring embeds a date, run id, or screen id, so this script survives every future real run on the ambient store.

Not applied here: iter-30's IN SCOPE also proposed suppressing the 'latest run' detail block's amber 'N members not reached' note and zeroed-counts line when the latest run is a reused done run (closing audit finding F1). Verified live against the ambient rig this iteration (2026-07-31): apps/frontend/app/desk/page.tsx's LatestScreenRunDetail still renders both data-testid="desk-screen-run-latest-unreached" ('101 members not reached') and data-testid="desk-screen-run-latest-counts" ('0 ranked ...') unconditionally for the latest reused run -- the frontend code was NOT changed this iteration (dev handoff: 'no code changes were planned or made'). This script therefore does not assert on the 'latest run' detail block at all (steps 2/3 target the append-only table, which is unaffected by F1's framing gap either way), so it stays valid regardless of whether/when F1 is fixed.

Step 4 is a post-match liveness check (the iter-4/iter-5 lesson this project's other golden scripts also apply): a further /desk navigation AFTER the key text match, proving the page is still alive and rendering correctly, not merely that the match happened a moment before a crash.
